purpose: Choose a local desktop embedding default using synthetic Chinese private-chat retrieval, not reply generation quality.
queryOrder: A seeded shuffle per run, identical across models for that run.
encodingInput: Candidate text is its input situation only. Replies, qrels, categories, family IDs and annotations are never passed to encoders.
truncation: Keep the most recent tokens within 512, preserving model-specific instruction and required special tokens.
qwenQueryInstruction: Given a Chinese chat situation, retrieve past chat situations with a similar communication intent and interpersonal context.
primaryMetric: test nDCG@4 on current-production raw query representation

queryRepresentations.primary: raw: strip only leading 本人/我/对方 speaker labels from canonical query lines, retain text and line order, matching current worker recent-text concatenation
queryRepresentations.ablation: role-explicit: preserve canonical speaker labels, same candidates and qrels; extra queries encoded once, not used for default model selection or main latency
queryRepresentations.candidate: canonical 本人/对方 speaker-labelled input situation, as produced by self_samples; candidate reply remains hidden from encoders

diagnosticCutoff: @10 extends the display limit solely for diagnosis; production reply suggestions use at most 4 examples.
splitPolicy: Scenario families are separated between dev and test. All candidates remain searchable. Freeze data and labels after independent review, before any model results are examined.
tuning: No test-set tuning; production fusion and all model instructions are fixed before running.
semanticFloorDiagnostic: Keep production cosine >= 0.2 for the main seven rows. Report the fraction of relevant and eligible candidates removed by this fixed floor for each model; cosine distributions need not be calibrated alike. This is a pipeline comparison, not a claim that the models have identical score scales.
memoryDiagnostic: For each of the seven retrieval methods, sample the sum of coexisting owned ranking-worker and optional encoder RSS/private memory every 10ms over the same seeded 16 warm queries. Includes benchmark Python/NumPy/data/vector overhead, excludes coordinator and full app. Report this sampled working-set peak separately from OS encoder process peak; do not sum independent process lifetime peaks.

decisionPolicy.modelSelectionMethod: Compare the three models using hybrid test nDCG@4. Treat models within 0.02 absolute nDCG@4 as practically tied and prefer lower measured latency, memory and download size. A heavier replacement should improve nDCG@4 by at least 0.03, have paired 95% CI above zero, and not reduce Hit@4 by more than 0.02. Also report the pure-semantic versus hybrid result; do not conceal a hybrid regression.
decisionPolicy.interpretation: Warm-query guardrail uses the all-query combined component-sum P95 over all three runs (480 observations/model/method); it is not an application end-to-end SLA. Memory guardrail uses maximum isolated encoder OS RSS peak over those three runs. Guardrails are for this measured CPU desktop configuration, not a promise for all devices. Publish failures, uncertainty and Pareto tradeoffs; retain the existing default if evidence for changing it is insufficient. Quantized variants and GPU deployments are outside this round.

performanceScope: Warm query latency includes local encoder IPC and tokenization/inference; ranking is measured separately and combined per query. It excludes Core HTTP authorization, original-message proof verification, model queue contention and final generation. Model load is process-cold with uncontrolled OS file cache. Peak memory is one isolated encoder process, not system-wide RAM.
privacy: Only purpose-written synthetic conversations. No real chats, profiles, contacts, model credentials or private configuration are included in artifacts.
